Priya (security): Heads up  scheduling a small base-image rebuild on staging Friday 08:30 PT. Focus: remove old ssh clients, upgrade libssl, and enable cosign KMS signing.
Omar (eng-infra): OK. Will this require new KMS keys or reuse the existing staging key?
Priya (security): New key: projects/redwood/kms/locations/global/keyRings/img/cryptoKeys/stg-2026-rot. Need RBAC for builder SA to sign.
Kai (runtime): Runtime should accept previous key for a short overlap. I can add a dual-key check behind a flag.
Sasha (SRE): Also confirm we export DATA_ACCESS logs for `asymmetricSign` to our audit pipeline. I can validate after infra changes.
Omar (eng-infra): I'll add a sink filtering `protoPayload.methodName:"cryptoKeyVersions.asymmetricSign"` and send to the audit index.
Priya (security): IAM snippet I plan to add to the PR:
- members: [serviceAccount:builder-staging@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com]
  role: roles/cloudkms.signerVerifier
Omar (eng-infra): That's fine. We'll make the grant time-limited and remove 2 hours after rollout.
Kai (runtime): If signing fails, fallback plan: pause rollout and let runtime accept the old key. We'll flag and roll back images if needed.
sec-bot: Reminder: run `scripts/image-preflight.sh staging` and `scripts/check-audit-sink.sh` before the window.
Priya (security): Action items: Omar - create KMS key + PR; Kai - dual-key flag and canary; Sasha - verify audit sink and alerting. I'll draft revoke steps post-cutover.
Omar (eng-infra): I'll open the terraform PR in ~2h.
Kai (runtime): Will push a tiny runtime canary and ping here.
Sasha (SRE): I'll validate the sink and confirm Splunk shows sign events.
Priya (security): Thanks team. If anything blocks the window call it out here or DM me. :thumbsup:
